children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Prove a module locally, publish immutable OCI bundles, and use digest pinning and signatures for trustworthy upgrades.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A signature mismatch must leave the Module failed without replacing the last known-good GameTemplate.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Validate and install through the same source path users will run, then exercise every advertised capability and version.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Validate metadata/schema, wait for sync, and check LocalesValid=Valid when translated (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Test create, readiness, console, files, players, backup, restore, and stop.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Verify previous version-specific PVCs survive version/loader switches.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use semantic versions and immutable digests, then test discovery, explicit installation, rollback, and source failure.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Keep catalog refresh separate from explicit install/upgrade.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Test bad bundles, missing versions, uninstall blockers, and recovery.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Sign official bundles by digest, publish the matching public key, and keep private keys only in CI Secrets.
